The opportunity journal

Political opportunities, mapped.

Opportunity Radar is a free, searchable guide to opportunities for conservatives, classical liberals, libertarians and anyone right of centre or pro-market. It tracks internships, jobs, fellowships, scholarships, conferences, summer schools and essay contests at think tanks and policy organisations around the world. Every listing links to the official page, with deadlines and eligibility, so you can find what's open to you and apply in time.
